artifacts.summary: 15-phase plan for TM+ deterministic completeness, the axiomatize-without-defining coincidence corollary, non-definability of the stability modal, pasting-axiom underivability, and the conservativity corollaries.

memory_candidates.content: When a Lean completeness engine ends in a single application of its validity hypothesis to a concretely constructed countermodel frame (the shape `h_valid.apply F TM tau h_tot t`), the engine can be re-read with an arbitrarily narrowed validity hypothesis at near-zero cost: add one existential binder carrying the frame property to the countermodel producer and supply the witness. In this tree every completeness countermodel frame already carried a proved fibre-subsingleton lemma, which is definitionally the determinism predicate, so class-restricted completeness was a signature widening rather than a new proof. The corollary generalises: before planning a new canonical-model construction for a restricted frame class, check whether the existing engine's countermodel already lies in that class.
